newsitem.title: USA: Nasdaq extends rally, hits 8th new high.
newsitem.headline: Nasdaq extends rally, hits 8th new high.

text.p: Nasdaq shares extended its recent rally, hitting its eighth consecutive record closing high, as technology stocks made broad gains, traders said.

The Nasdaq composite index gained 21.25 points or 1.41 percent to close unofficially at 1523.87, the 25th record for the year. Advancing issues beat decliners 2289 to 2060 on total volume of 690 million shares.
"It's been pretty broad, pretty tireless streak. But techs had been so soft earlier this year that there was room for some gains," one trader said.
The rally touched large capitalization and small issues alike, other traders said. The Russell 2000 index, a key barometer of small capitalization stocks, up 1.59 points or 0.40 percent to 403.85.
Microsoft Corp and Dell Computer Corp hit new 52-week highs, while Intel Corp gained 1-7/8 to 78-3/4 in its first day of trading on a post-split basis.

Ascend Communications Inc gained 4-11/16 to 52-11/16 after Goldman Sachs initiated coverage of the networking company and added it to its recommended list. Netscape Communications Corp surged 5-7/8 to 44-3/8 after Cowen & Co upgraded the stock to strong buy from buy.
